description:
Detailed performance for one prompt (one question Refora asks the AI models on a schedule): visibility over time, per-model visibility and answers, every brand its answers name (own, tracked competitor or other), its status against the tracked competitors, and the URLs cited in its answers.

Use this tool when the user asks about a specific prompt -- phrases like 'how are we doing on the prompt about X', 'who wins the question about X', 'details on this prompt', or as drill-down after list_prompts or get_competitor_visibility_gap.

Name the prompt by its text: the full text as another Refora tool returned it, or a distinctive part of it. Prompts with the same text are one question and are measured together. If several prompts match, the response lists them so the user can pick. model narrows it to some AI models.

Example: 'How are we doing on the prompt about enterprise CRM?'

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 365. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

model.description: Optional: count only answers from these AI models. One model, or a list such as ["openai", "google-aio"]. openai = ChatGPT, anthropic = Claude, mistral = Le Chat, google-aio = Google AI Overviews. Omit for every model.
model.title: Model

prompt_text.description: The prompt's text, exactly as another Refora tool returned it, or a distinctive part of it. Matched case-insensitively.
prompt_text.title: Prompt Text

resolution.description: Length of each trend period. Default 'week': prompts run on a schedule, so 'day' leaves empty periods.
resolution.title: Resolution

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

workspace_id.description: The workspace's numeric id, as returned by list_workspaces.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: get_prompt_performance
title: Prompt performance
